# Bint-e-Shauq

> Premium Pakistani women's clothing storefront at https://www.binteshauq.store — embroidered suits, kurtas, and seasonal collections. Founded by Sadia Ismail. Prices in PKR. Guest checkout is supported.

Bint-e-Shauq (brand name; founder credit: Sadia Ismail) sells thoughtfully designed women's wear with a focus on embroidered suits, kurtas, and seasonal collections such as Winter ’25 Karandi shawl suits. Product pages use `/products/{slug}`; collection pages use `/collections/{slug}`. Private areas (`/admin`, `/cart`, `/checkout`, `/account`, `/orders`, `/auth`) are not intended for indexing. Full URL list for crawlers: the sitemap.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.binteshauq.store/): Brand landing and featured products
- [Shop](https://www.binteshauq.store/shop): Full catalog with filters
- [New arrivals](https://www.binteshauq.store/new-arrivals): Latest products
- [About](https://www.binteshauq.store/about): Brand and founder story
- [Contact](https://www.binteshauq.store/contact): Customer contact
- [FAQ](https://www.binteshauq.store/faq): Common questions
- [Policies](https://www.binteshauq.store/policies): Store policies
- [Size guide](https://www.binteshauq.store/size-guide): Sizing reference

## Collections

- [Karandi Shawl Suits](https://www.binteshauq.store/collections/karandi-shawl-suits): Winter ’25 Karandi shawl suits
- [Blossom](https://www.binteshauq.store/collections/blossom): Blossom collection
- [Linear](https://www.binteshauq.store/collections/linear): Linear collection
- [Flora](https://www.binteshauq.store/collections/flora): Flora collection
- [Stitched](https://www.binteshauq.store/collections/stitched): Stitched collection
